records.footnote: Data are used for SDG 7.3.1 'Energy intensity measured in terms of primary energy and GDP'. Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 7.3.1. Data refer to energy intensity (toe per million dollars of real GDP), which is the energy consumption per Gross Domestic Product (GDP) in Chained (2015) dollars. Figures may be periodically updated as more accurate data are made available.
